red_imagescale_from_pinholes.pro


Routines

top source red_imagescale_from_pinholes

SST pipeline

result = red_imagescale_from_pinholes(pref, isodate [, fitinfo=struct] [, rawfile=string])

Calculate the image scale by use of pinhole grid pitch measurements.

Return value

The image scale in arcsec/pixel. (0 if failed.)

Parameters

pref in type=string

The prefilter.

isodate

Keywords

fitinfo out optional type=struct

The output from red_fitgrid.

rawfile in optional type=string

Use raw pinhole image from this file rather than summed pinhole images.
